return $input.all().map((item, index) => {
	const p = item.json || {};

	const relationshipEvidence =
		p.relationship_evidence ??
		p.analysis?.relationship_evidence ??
		p.top_candidate_reason?.relationship_evidence ??
		null;

	const topCandidateReason =
		p.top_candidate_reason ?? null;

	const targetCompany =
		p.target?.current_company ??
		p.target?.company ??
		p.target_company ??
		p.company ??
		p.current_company ??
		"";

	const detectedSkills =
		Array.isArray(p.detected_skills)
			? p.detected_skills
			: Array.isArray(p.analysis?.detected_skills)
				? p.analysis.detected_skills
				: [];

	return {
		json: {
			...p,

			profile_id:
				p.profile_id ??
				p.id ??
				index + 1,

			target_company: targetCompany,

			relationship_evidence: relationshipEvidence,

			top_candidate_reason: topCandidateReason,

			profile: {
				name: p.name ?? "",
				linkedin_url: p.linkedin_url ?? "",
				headline: p.headline ?? "",
				position: p.position ?? "",
				current_company: p.current_company ?? "",
				location: p.location ?? "",
				about: p.about ?? "",

				experience: Array.isArray(p.experience)
					? p.experience
					: [],

				education: Array.isArray(p.education)
					? p.education
					: [],

				skills: Array.isArray(p.skills)
					? p.skills
					: [],

				followers: p.followers ?? 0,
				connections: p.connections ?? 0,

				mutual_connections:
					p.mutual_connections ??
					relationshipEvidence?.mutual_connections ??
					0
			},

			analysis: {
				...(p.analysis || {}),

				role:
					p.role ??
					p.analysis?.role ??
					"Unknown",

				seniority:
					p.seniority ??
					p.analysis?.seniority ??
					"Unknown",

				decision_power:
					p.decision_power ??
					p.analysis?.decision_power ??
					"Unknown",

				hiring_influence:
					p.hiring_influence ??
					p.analysis?.hiring_influence ??
					"Unknown",

				warm_score:
					p.warm_score ??
					p.analysis?.warm_score ??
					0,

				warm_grade:
					p.warm_grade ??
					p.analysis?.warm_grade ??
					"N/A",

				detected_skills: detectedSkills,

				relationship_evidence: relationshipEvidence
			}
		}
	};
});

const all = $input.all();
const top3 = all.slice(0, 3);

return [
	{
		json: {
			generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
			total_candidates: all.length,

			top_3: top3.map((item, index) => {
				const p = item.json ?? {};

				const relationshipEvidence =
					p.relationship_evidence ??
					p.analysis?.relationship_evidence ??
					p.ai_analysis?.relationship_evidence ??
					null;

				const topCandidateReason =
					p.top_candidate_reason ??
					null;

				return {
					rank: p.rank ?? index + 1,

					// Basic profile
					name:
						p.profile?.name ??
						p.name ??
						"",

					company:
						p.profile?.current_company ??
						p.current_company ??
						p.company ??
						"",

					position:
						p.profile?.position ??
						p.position ??
						"",

					linkedin:
						p.profile?.linkedin_url ??
						p.linkedin_url ??
						p.linkedin ??
						"",

					location:
						p.profile?.location ??
						p.location ??
						"",

					// Scores
					final_score:
						p.final_score ??
						p.score ??
						0,

					final_grade:
						p.final_grade ??
						p.grade ??
						"N/A",

					// Analysis
					role:
						p.analysis?.role ??
						p.role ??
						"Unknown",

					seniority:
						p.analysis?.seniority ??
						p.seniority ??
						"Unknown",

					decision_power:
						p.analysis?.decision_power ??
						p.decision_power ??
						"Unknown",

					hiring_influence:
						p.analysis?.hiring_influence ??
						p.hiring_influence ??
						"Unknown",

					// AI
					recommendation:
						p.ai_analysis?.overall_recommendation ??
						p.recommendation ??
						"Unknown",

					relationship_strength:
						p.ai_analysis?.relationship_strength?.level ??
						p.relationship_strength ??
						"Unknown",

					personalized_introduction:
						p.ai_analysis?.personalized_introduction ??
						p.personalized_introduction ??
						p.introduction ??
						"",

					// Required frontend reasoning fields
					relationship_evidence: relationshipEvidence,
					top_candidate_reason: topCandidateReason,

					// Keep full objects for future use
					profile: p.profile ?? null,

					analysis: {
						...(p.analysis ?? {}),
						relationship_evidence: relationshipEvidence
					},

					ai_analysis: {
						...(p.ai_analysis ?? {}),
						relationship_evidence: relationshipEvidence
					}
				};
			})
		}
	}
];
